notes.title: Patch 6 is now live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35094678/bcdfb51418786aa6387dfd5e0dafedef9e8800ad.jpg[/img]

Greetings, Warriors, 

We just rolled out a patch that fixes several recurring issues. Please find the patch notes below. 


[h1][b]Patch notes [/b][/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Eli could suddenly die during the fight at the University without even being touched.
[*] Fixed an issue where Nano Echo in the boss fight would have a voice line in English.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could cancel falling animation when using attack and block during the fall.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could survive the fall from the epicenter and skip the fight against Cain.
[*] Fixed an issue where blocking animation would not play completely. 
[*] Fixed an issue where implants could not be equipped in another NG if you equipped it on an unlockable implant slot in NG+.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could get stuck between container and outdoor toilet.
[*] Fixed an issue where poison/shark bots could become untouchable after getting out of the ground.
[*] Fixed an issue where save data from Patch 5 could not be launched on GMC version.
[*] Fixed an issue where players were unable to complete Iron Maus side quest even if the steps were fulfilled correctly. 
[*] Fixed an issue with nano weapons that could not cut limbs off big pirates.
[*] Several localization fixes
[*] Fixed a synchronization issue with the Kraken Birth Sequence when leaving this level before talking to zip-line.
[*] Fixed an issue with black squares appearing or flatting that can interfere with the image after decreasing the Resolution Scale.
[*] Fixed an issue with Brother Eli’s voice when he talked to the prisoner.
[*] Fixed an issue with bazooka enemies being invincible when players aimed at their body. 
[*] Fixed an issue where players could talk to Sidney at the drive-in while she’s at epicenter. 
[*] The Robotic Disrupter implant should work properly against robotic enemies in The Kraken expansion.
[*] Fixed an issue with audiolog, sausages, and music tape that cost 0 techscrap from the vending machine. 
[*] Fixed an issue with the Tenta Kill weapon that would continue playing the sound even when not swinging the weapon.
[*] Fixed an issue where players would get twice the same items when killing two enemies in a row. 
[*] Fixed an issue with crab enemies that could not be killed by a normal weapon.
[*] Fixed an issue where players would not need to parry multiple times against an enemy that was 2 levels higher than your weapon MK if you have a MK X weapon in your inventory. 
[*] Fixed an issue with a character equipped with a gear set that appeared from nowhere near the stairs.
[*] Fixed an issue where facial hair would not show properly when equipping certain headgear.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could die when jumping toward the wall in the Government level.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Ascension Quest that could be found in previous levels rather than in the Detention center. 
[*] Fixed an issue where a red FX would be reactivated in the eye when launching Cain into the swimming pool after you died. 
[*] Fixed some UI quest log names in The Kraken expansion. 
[*] Fixed an issue with Vulkan error [VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST GTX 960] that appeared when the game was launched.
[*] Fixed a crash when the player used Alt-tab while in fullscreen.
[*] Fixed a game freezing issue related to AMD driver update 19.12.2.
[*] 
[/list]

notes.title: The free JCPD Gear Pack DLC is out now!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/el3z61y.gif[/img]

Hello everyone, 
The Surge 2 continues to expand its collection of futuristic loot with the release of its [b]second free DLC - the JCPD Gear Pack[/b] - containing a whole new set of armor and four new implants! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35094678/d31d8ac3d4478aa9bca590b5197645206a1f33b1.jpg[/img]

Jericho City scientists have cooked up new toys for players to hunt down and acquire, such as the JCPD Team Zola armor set, which is all about [b]generating stamina to keep those combos going[/b]. Combine it with the Omni-Cell Battery Converter Implant which converts batteries into drone ammunition, and you can keep slaying without pause.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35094678/2f3be443be5facca76ac241d690c801001079af3.jpg[/img]

In addition, we also rolled out a patch that brings some new features and bug fixes, such as Nvidia Ansel support, an option to remove multiplayer tags, and so on. You can find the patch notes below. 

If you are not familiar with Ansel, below is a brief instruction. 

[list]
[*] Install GeForce Experience
[*] Launch The Surge 2
[*] Click on Alt+F2
[*] Once pressed, the game should automatically pause and the Ansel overlay should appear
[*] You can start playing the photo mode!
[/list]

[b]The free JCPD Gear Pack is available right now on PC for free. All future DLCs will be included in The Surge 2’s Season Pass, available for purchase on all platforms. [/b]

[b][url=http://thesurge-game.com/shop]Season Pass[/url] owners will also get a 48-hour head start on January’s The Kraken expansion, where they will explore new areas with new deadly threats. [/b]

[h1]Patch notes [/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Added Nvidia Ansel support[/b]
[*] You can now use an implant when another implant is still on cooldown.
[*] Added an option that allows to remove multiplayer tags
[*] Added the new free JCPD DLC
[*] Added a second enemy wielding Codename: Engelhart from the Public Enemy DLC in order to make sure that everyone can find this weapon
[*] Addressed various stability and performances issues
[*] Fixed various bugs
[/list]

notes.title: New patch & free weapon DLC!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35094678/b876ff714f2eabec8167bec54f649826d0c7f6c9.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone, 

[b]We’re excited to bring more content[/b] to the game and expand the collection of high-tech killing utensils with our [b]free Future Shock Weapon Pack[/b]. This pack adds four new vicious weapons today on PlayStation 4 and PC, and tomorrow on Xbox One. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35094678/85ae03bb0f13e6b63a4b1d7acd2b7fa201b949ae.jpg[/img]

This free Weapon Pack includes the deadly Golden Twin Blades, the devastating “BFH” Heavy Duty Weapon, the brutal Mangled Articulators Punching Gloves, and the versatile Golden Harvest Double Duty Weapon. Find the enemies wielding them and execute them to claim the weapons for yourself!

And that is only the beginning. Stay tuned as next week will see the [b]full reveal of The Surge 2’s Season Pass[/b], with more weapons, more implants, more gear sets, and [b]a brand-new storyline DLC with hours of content[/b] in a new environment to be released down the line.

We also released a patch for PC, featuring bug fixes and improvements. Read the patch notes below!

[h1]Patch notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved optimizations for different hardware drivers
[*] Texture streaming turned off on GPUs with 6 GB VRAM
[*] Very High texture settings forces hight LOD textures: game should look crisper
[*] Fixed a control issue with QWERTY keyboards for the spraycan drone
[*] Fixed an issue with auto-setting Dynamic Resolution (blurry textures by default effect)
[*] Several crash fixes
[*] Fixed blockers when interacting with some doors
[*] Fixes a crash when performing a finisher on NanoBeast’s bodies
[*] Fixed an issue where you would be stuck in Power Plant when trying to exit this area
[*] Fixed an issue with A.I.D. Centauri set bonus
[*] Fixed several issues with The Witness quest
[*] The new implant slot should now display correctly if you reach 100 Core Power.
[*] “Jump” and “Cycle Injectables” can now be bound after resetting key bindings to default
[*] Fixed an issue where you would receive multiple rewards from a single banner
[*] Fixed some localization issues
[*] Fixed an issue with R2 double tap
[*] [Balancing] Delver Echo in NG+ has been nerfed
[*] Fixed an issue where music volume would automatically reset or set to 0 when launching the game
[*] Adjusted “brightness” slider
[*] Fixed an issue where you would suddenly die in the Underground
[*] Swiss Army Drone can now be unlocked in NG+
[*] Reduced cost of Graffiti Tags from merchants
[*] Various bug fixes
[/list]

As usual, please give us any feedback with regards to the changes or the game. If you encounter other technical issues or in-game bugs, please make a thread on our [url=https://forums.focus-home.com/category/289/the-surge-2-technical-feedback]official forums[/url] or [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/644830/discussions/]Steam forums[/url] with as much detail as possible (i.e. DxDiag, game logs).

Thanks again for your support.

[i]The Surge 2 Team [/i]

notes.title: Update #1 is LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/SjylLZX.gif[/img]

Hello everyone!

Our first update is live! Thanks to reports from all of you, we have been able to identify and resolve a number of technical issues. 

Also, we updated our beta branch [b]liveops_beta[/b] (accessible through right clicking on Surge 2 in your library> Properties > Betas) with an even more updated build with further fixes.

We will continue to work hard to improve everyone's experience in The Surge 2!

[h1]Change Log Main Branch[/h1]
[list]
[*] Stuttering fix
[*] Rendering crash fix (launch crash)
[*] Works on Win7 (xinput1_4.dll added to depot)
[*] In some rare cases the onboard GPU would set to GPU 0. The game will now check which of your GPUs is the dedicated one and use that instead.
[*] Fixed an issue with Inventory keybind input
[/list]

[h1]Change Log Beta branch: liveops_beta[/h1]
[list]
[*] All the above fixes
[*] Hawkes Audiolog no longer causes a crash
[*] Finishing the body of a nano beast in T0 PC and T7 will no longer cause a crash
[*] Implants show correctly at core power 100+
[/list]

If you are still experiencing stuttering, we are interested to know if it’s in specific areas or if it can happen anywhere.

If you are experiencing general performance issues (not only stuttering, but abnormally low framerate), we are interested in getting some more details (dxdiag and logs).

We are still working on a solution for the visual issues some of you are experiencing, as well as the other crashes.

As usual, if you encounter any other technical issues or bugs, please make a post on our [url=https://forums.focus-home.com/category/286/the-surge-2]official forums[/url] or [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/644830/discussions/1/]Steam Technical Support[/url], with as much detail as possible (dxdiag, game logs).

Thanks.

The Surge 2 Team

notes.title: Community Update#3: Hotfix Beta Branch 26/09/2019
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/MaNFUIF.gif[/img]

Hello, 

We’re very thankful for your feedback since release. We really appreciate it. As we mentioned yesterday, the team are hard at work addressing some recurring and urgent issues. 

Thanks to your feedback, we can today [b]update our beta branch “liveops_beta“ that should fix the FLR crash and improve the stuttering issue[/b].

Please find the patch notes below.

[h1]System and Optimization [/h1]
[list]
[*] Stuttering 
[list]
[*] We further improved the issue with stuttering that was caused by texture streaming. We still have an open issue with vsync, so to check if it’s better for you we suggest to set the vsync to OFF
[/list]
[*] FLR Error Crash
[list]
[*] Should you experience any more, please make a new thread in Technical Support with the error message, your DxDiag.txt as well as you logs (C:\Users\XXX\Documents\The Surge 2\logs). 
[/list]
[*] GPU
[list]
[*] In some rare cases the onboard GPU is set to GPU 0. The game will now check which of your GPUs is the dedicated one and use that instead. Potentially this could occur with every CPU that has an onboard GPU.
[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Known Issue[/h1]
[list]
[*] If you reset your keybindings to default, Jump and Cycle Injectable will be unbound. This will be fixed in an official patch. In the meantime, please do not reset to default your keybindings.
[/list]

As usual, please give any feedback you may have with this hotfix. If you encounter other technical issues or in-game bugs, please make a post on our [url=https://forums.focus-home.com/category/289/the-surge-2-technical-feedback]official forums[/url] or [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/644830/discussions/1/]Steam Technical Support[/url], with as much detail as possible (dxdiag, game logs). 

Thanks.

The Surge 2 Team

notes.title: Community Update #2: Hotfix Beta Branch 25/09/19
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/W4brchT.gif[/img]

Hello, 

Thank you so much for all your feedback since the release yesterday. We are really hard at work addressing some recurring and urgent technical issues. 

Today we invite you to try out the beta version of our next hotfix, including [b]keybind and some potential performance fixes[/b].  

[h1]Change log[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with Inventory keybind input
[*] Potential stuttering fix
[*] FLR Crash fix : [url=https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/help/929833/use-the-system-file-checker-tool-to-repair-missing-or-corrupted-system]file checker tool[/url]
[/list]

For now, we advise you to try the following settings when you play The Surge 2:
[list]
[*] V-Sync = off
[*] FPS limit = 90
[*] Anti-Aliasing = TAA or off
[/list]
We hope this could fix your performance issues. Please give us your feedback on this. 

Please keep us updated in the replies on the current performance state for you with this beta branch. 

[h1]FLR Crash fix [/h1]
Use the Windows file checker to repair corrupted files: [url=https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/help/929833/use-the-system-file-checker-tool-to-repair-missing-or-corrupted-system]file checker tool[/url]

[h1]How to access this beta branch?[/h1]
[list]
[*] Go to your Steam Library.
[*] Right click on The Surge 2 then choose “Properties”.
[*] Go into the “Beta” tab and select “liveops_beta” in the drop down menu.
[*] Download the new version and launch the game.
[/list]

[b]Before launching the beta branch, please make sure to back up your saves: D:\Steam\userdata\XXX\644830\remote[/b]

If you still have performance issues, please send an email to support@focus-home.com with a brief introduction of the issue, alongside your DxDiag and log file. This will help us identify the issue and find a fix. 

[h1]How to find my log files?[/h1]
[list]
[*] Go to C:\Users\XXX\Documents\The Surge 2\logs and zip the folder
[*] Send the files and the link to your Steam thread to support@focus-home.com 
[/list]

[b]If you are still encountering the error message “0XC0000005”, please update your GPU drivers. [/b]

AMD owners: http://support.amd.com/en-us/download
[list]
[*] Please install the Adrenalin 2019 Edition 19.9.2 or higher
[/list]
NVIDIA owners: http://www.nvidia.com/Download/index.aspx?lang=en-us
[list]
[*] Please install the 436.30 Game Ready Drivers or higher
[/list]

If you encounter other technical issues, we advise you to read our technical [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/644830/discussions/1/1628538005524422214/]FAQ[/url]. If the issue you’re experiencing still persists, please make a thread in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/644830/discussions/1/]technical support[/url] with as much detail as possible. 

Thanks!

The Surge 2 Team

notes.title: First Update on its way
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/dRBa51Z.gif[/img]

Hi everyone,

The Surge 2 has released this morning and we've spent the day reading reviews, watching streams and videos, and compiling your feedback on forums and social networks.

[b]Thank you so much for playing the game and posting your feedback![/b] As this sequel is strongly influenced by community reports from The Surge 1, we're delighted to hear that many of you are loving The Surge 2!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35094678/8d47c9fcc684afd1ff04d97c6054c11b59892024.png[/img]

We're aware that some of you encounter technical issues and [b]a first patch is on its way to fix the most urgent problems.[/b] Please find below a quick overview of the fixes we're working on right now.

[h1][b]Our current priorities[/b][/h1][list][*][b]Stutters and performance issues[/b][/list]
While we we work on improving the performances, we advise you to activate adaptative v-sync and nvidia triple buffering. It should improve your framerate.
[list][*][b]Investigate and fix various crashes at launch[/b][/list]
Namely the crashes at launch with the messages "FLR" and "VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST".

We're going through logs from players as we speak to investigate the issue. If you encounter these specific errors, please do as follow:
[list][*]Please download the settings.ini [url=https://we.tl/t-mNXCttA1Yy]here[/url]
[*]Put it here C:\Users\XXX\Documents\The Surge 2
[*]Launch the game
[*]Should crash
[*]Go here: C:\Users\XXX\Documents\The Surge 2\logs
[*]Send the files to support@focus-home.com. It will be help us a lot![/list]
The crash at launch "0XC0000005" is caused by the lack of drivers update. If you get this error, [b]please update your GPU drivers.[/b]

We also strongly advise to check our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/644830/discussions/1/1628538005524422214/]technical FAQ[/url] if you're having any issue.

We hope to be able to share a first update in a Beta branch really soon to get your feedback about it.

Thanks for reading and talk to you soon,
[i]The Surge 2 Team[/i]

notes.title: DevBlog #3 - Combat System (Part 1)
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/kUovZj2.gif[/img]

[i]The Surge 2, our hardcore Action-RPG featuring brutal exo-skeleton combat on a dying earth, comes to PlayStation 4, Xbox One, and PC on September 24th!

As we draw close to the release, we’re sharing a series of devblogs that we hope will give you some insight into the creative process of The Surge 2.

Check out our previous DevBlogs here:

1. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/644830/announcements/detail/3267843285202953142]Level Design[/url]
2. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/644830/announcements/detail/1608268640175945170]Sound Design[/url]

Today, we’re happy to have Sven, Lead Game Designer on The Surge 2, talking about the Combat System of the game![/i]

[b]Hi! Could you please introduce yourself and what you do on The Surge 2?[/b]

Hi there! My name is Sven and I’ve been with Deck13 for about 12 years now, working as Lead Game Designer on The Surge and The Surge 2. Together with a team of Game Designers I’m working on a variety of gameplay topics including the combat system of The Surge 2 in general and on all of its details.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35094678/86b891fcefd4a6f81075d3d02686a5fcda667a55.jpg[/img]

[b]There are many new features coming to the combat in The Surge 2. Could you give us a brief rundown of what’s new?[/b]

It will be hard to list all of the features that are new to the combat of The Surge 2 because there really are quite many, but let’s try to name at least some.

[i]Parry System[/i]
There is now a parry system called Directional Blocking. This will allow players to parry incoming attacks in the direction they are coming from. If done successfully, it leaves the attacker in a vulnerable state for a devastating counter attack.

[i]Drones and weapon types[/i]
The new combat drone will give players a variety of different ranged and utility options to survive the challenging fights, while the nine weapon types will let players choose their own preferred close combat style.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/n1PfU1q.gif[/img]

[i]Charged Attacks[/i]
All weapon types will feature charged attacks that are especially handy when fighting against shielded enemies or enemies that use attachments to buff up their combat abilities. Sometimes also just to quickly gather more combat energy.

[i]Combo System[/i]
The combo system of all weapons has been reworked quite a bit and combo attacks in general are now much more powerful. Some are particularly effective against armored body parts and others against unarmored body parts.

[i]Partial Set Bonuses[/i]
All gear sets will now not only have a special set bonus when fully equipped but will also feature a partial set bonus that is active once 3 parts of the set are worn.

[i]Leveling up Character Stats[/i]
And last but not least leveling up your Core Power will now not only let you equip heavier gear and use more implants but will also grant you 2 Module Points that you can spend to level up one of your base character stats: health, stamina and battery efficiency.

[b]What would you say is the main difference between The Surge and The Surge 2 in how combat feels?[/b]

If you really compare them side by side I would say the combat in The Surge 2 feels more fluent, faster and in some ways also more aggressive. And to me the original The Surge never felt slow or anything like that. I mean I know that we did a lot of things to actually create the feeling I’m trying to describe right now but I’m still proud that it worked out so well.

Changes like the player being able to cancel out of attacks before the attack actually lands or being able to evade or block out of enemy combo attacks makes a big difference in how responsive the combat feels. And these are just two small examples of things that we tweaked and tried to improve on.

[b]There are many weapon types in The Surge 2. Could you talk a little about how you approached making them all feel fresh and unique?[/b]

In total we have nine weapon types in The Surge 2. Five of them should already be familiar to those who played the original The Surge and four are brand new additions to offer the player a wide variety of different combat styles.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=V3zu52jIPRU
When you look at the four new weapon types you will see that they are all quite unique and have something special that the other weapon types don’t have. The Double Duty for example. At first it looks and feels more like a Heavy Duty weapon, but as soon as you start double-tapping your attack buttons it shows its full potential and splits into two seperate weapon pieces that attack much faster. Or the Spear might sound like just another Staff weapon but it’s actually more than that. The Spear is in fact the only weapon type in The Surge 2 that uses light and heavy attacks instead of horizontal and vertical attacks because it’s centered around thrust attacks.

The five already known weapon types still received a complete overhaul to make them feel fresh. Like I already mentioned when talking about the new features of The Surge 2, all of the combo trees that we used in The Surge got renewed and we tried to highlight specials like our cross combo attacks a lot more to create a cool new combat feeling.

[i]Stay tuned for more insight into the development of The Surge 2 in our next articles! You can also check out the Behind The Scenes series "[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=l7bh2FQ1mZU&list=PLZ4kher7FeReKmhWBx2y13DKgHWN31F49]Deck13 Inside" on Youtube[/url]. The Surge 2 slices its way onto PS4, Xbox One, and PC on September 24th. Pre-Order now and get bonuses: http://thesurge-game.com/shop[/i]

tags.feature: There is now a parry system called Directional Blocking. This will allow players to parry incoming attacks in the direction they are coming from. If done successfully, it leaves the attacker in a vulnerable state for a devastating counter attack.

The new combat drone will give players a variety of different ranged and utility options to survive the challenging fights, while the nine weapon types will let players choose their own preferred close combat style.

All weapon types will feature charged attacks that are especially handy when fighting against shielded enemies or enemies that use attachments to buff up their combat abilities. Sometimes also just to quickly gather more combat energy.

The combo system of all weapons has been reworked quite a bit and combo attacks in general are now much more powerful. Some are particularly effective against armored body parts and others against unarmored body parts.
All gear sets will now not only have a special set bonus when fully equipped but will also feature a partial set bonus that is active once 3 parts of the set are worn.

And last but not least leveling up your Core Power will now not only let you equip heavier gear and use more implants but will also grant you 2 Module Points that you can spend to level up one of your base character stats: health, stamina and battery efficiency.

Changes like the player being able to cancel out of attacks before the attack actually lands or being able to evade or block out of enemy combo attacks makes a big difference in how responsive the combat feels.

The Double Duty for example. At first it looks and feels more like a Heavy Duty weapon, but as soon as you start double-tapping your attack buttons it shows its full potential and splits into two seperate weapon pieces that attack much faster.
The Spear is in fact the only weapon type in The Surge 2 that uses light and heavy attacks instead of horizontal and vertical attacks because it’s centered around thrust attacks.

Like I already mentioned when talking about the new features of The Surge 2, all of the combo trees that we used in The Surge got renewed and we tried to highlight specials like our cross combo attacks a lot more to create a cool new combat feeling.

notes.title: Devblog #1 - Level Design
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/I030mon.gif[/img]

[i]The Surge 2, our hardcore Action-RPG featuring brutal exo-skeleton combat on a dying earth, comes to PlayStation 4, Xbox One, and PC on September 24th!

As we draw close to the release, we’ll be sharing a series of devblogs that we hope will give you some insight into the creative process of The Surge 2.

Today, we’re happy to have [b]Alexander Bönicke[/b], Game Designer on The Surge 2, talking about the [b]Level Design[/b] of the game! [/i]

Hey! My name is Alex, I’ve been with Deck13 for about 3 years now, working as a Designer on the Design and World team. I contributed to The Surge and its DLCs and have been working on The Surge 2 since its inception.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/88PULNm.jpg[/img]
[i]Alexander Bönicke, Game Designer on The Surge 2[/i]

The time to talk about Level Design is just right, because with the work on the Walk in the Park DLC for The Surge and especially during the development of Surge 2, [b]Deck13 iterated on the world creation and design process to address the feedback we received after the release of The Surge[/b].

A closer relationship between Art Direction and Game Design allowed us to shape the game world more freely and iterate on its visuals and user experience more thoroughly.

On top of addressing the incredible amount of feedback we received from our players we also set out to turn The Surge formula on its head to create a new game experience.
Thus we chose [b]Jericho City as the stage for the game[/b] – a place that offers countless opportunities for players to fight, explore and immerse themselves. With this plan on paper, we set out to:

[list]
[*] build a game world with a [b]more natural and open feel[/b] – featuring more varied environments
[*] offer [b]more choice in how to approach the game[/b] – on a micro and macro scale
[*] [b]improve mobility and options[/b] of the player character, in combat and during world exploration
[*] create a more varied and [b]deeper narrative experience[/b]
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/MoQB5Qd.png[/img]
[i]Concept Art of Jericho City[/i]

With a great playground comes great responsibility, so Jericho City and its outskirts naturally come with a price tag.

The long vistas through the spacious streets and alleys of Downtown, the rich and plentiful flora overgrowing Gideon’s Rock, and the Cultist-riddled swamps of Port Nixon are only some of the technical challenges we had to overcome while keeping and even one-upping the visual quality of The Surge. 

However, populating the game world has not only been a technical challenge:

[list]
[*] [b]there are many NPCs to interact with[/b], side quests to complete, and decisions players can make to influence the inhabitants of the city - a very complex network of narrative content to maintain and develop
[*] [b]more verticality in level design and more player mobility[/b] made it harder to assure the levels work as intended (as in preventing players from getting into undesired places)
[*] [b]in an open, non-linear environment with so many options[/b], informing players of their goals and helping them orient themselves (guidance) is a very difficult issue to address and track
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CW9GoJt.gif[/img]
[i]Take a ride on the mag lift[/i]

In a project of this scale it’s hard to play favorites. So when it comes to the thing I am most proud of it’s a tough decision. [b]Downtown Jericho is probably the largest and most complex level we have ever created[/b]. It connects almost all areas of the game and over the entirety of the playthrough it offers fresh challenges as well as a myriad of nooks and crannies to uncover. While it was certainly the hardest level to fully implement, it’s also probably the most satisfying for us to play – each and every day we return to it.

As mentioned above we tried to be aware of what made The Surge unique. So [b]we opted to stick to the idea of having only one save point per level (for the most part!)[/b] and utilized what the setting – a vast city center –  gave us to connect everything smartly.

Not only while exploring the alleys of Downtown Jericho – all areas in the game offer a network of clever, interconnected streets, indoor locations, tunnels, even super efficient ziplines players can utilize to unlock the game world for themselves – one step at a time.

As they make their way through the levels, players will naturally open chests, break boxes and turn over every stone. They will uncover every nook and cranny, make impossible jumps, and explore pitch-black caverns on the hunt for loot and gear parts.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GvS0mGo.gif[/img]
[i]Downtown Jericho[/i]

Jericho City and its adjacent districts offer various distinct places for players to visit. All areas of the game are directly interconnected and can be visited by foot (and other more efficient means of travel players might discover during the playthrough).

Some of these areas are accessible as soon as players set their first foot into Jericho City, though we make sure that there is a 'recommended order' gated by the difficulty of gameplay encounters. Players may still try to challenge themselves by choosing their own route through the game – and might discover some unique interactions this way.

Ultimately all paths contribute towards a goal players will uncover and chase, so some later areas will only become accessible as the story progresses…

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0e7zI9Ynr5s
[b]Please allow me to shamelessly use my last seconds of fame to express that I am very proud of my team and myself for what an enormous game world we created.[/b] It has been a wild ride and an incredible experience, and the experience keeps giving every day when I'm jumping in and exploring Jericho City. [b]We hope you share our feelings when Surgetember arrives.[/b] 

[i]Stay tuned for more insight into the development of The Surge 2 in our next articles! The Surge 2 slices its way onto PS4, Xbox One, and PC on September 24th. Pre-Order now and get bonuses: http://thesurge-game.com/shop[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/644830/The_Surge_2/
